title: Shared datatype values and family contracts

acceptance.description: Implement owned immutable datatype support shared by the value families: exact type metadata/whitespace policy, bounded normalization, immutable list/union and retyping support, and a precise internal family-provider contract compatible with the frozen IXmlDatatypeLibrary/XmlDatatypeValue interfaces. Freeze all family dispatch, error, comparison/hash and budget joins in an owned report before family implementations start; do not provide fake successful parsers or a partial advertised library.

Test XML-only whitespace, Unicode scalar handling, input snapshots/retained ownership, list/union selected-member identity, declared-type preservation, cancellation and exact operation/component boundaries. Compiled consumers must use only verified M8-model plus this task; later family behavior is not claimed.

Record exact internal helper/family contracts and focused checks at the tested revision. Provide applicable normalization/setup allocation evidence with owned output separated from borrowed primitives; preserve public API and earlier checks.

handoff.summary: Planned bounded child of M8-datatypes; original complete XSD1.0 acceptance and gate reachability preserved.
